metas.name: Stalin Sivadas
metas.description:

Sivadas is a dedicated communist party member who gains the good will of poor and faces a strong opposition from other political parties.

Sukumaran, a budding politician, neglects his wife as he focuses on his career. As a result, their relationship weakens leading to a separation.
